name: Bitcoin
day_summary: The full Monday book confirmed the weekend breakout — and then some. The US–Iran peace deal was declared 'now complete' with Hormuz reopening, oil cratered, the Nasdaq ripped +2.38%, and BTC pushed +2.3% to ~$66,831, holding decisively above the $65,000 re-risk trigger and printing a $67,302 high. This is the level the markets briefings flagged for weeks: BTC has climbed back ABOVE the $66K re-entry threshold. Bulls regained control of the regime. The one thing capping full conviction: the FOMC lands Wednesday June 17, and Warsh's rate path is the last gate.

decision.rationale: The trigger fired. The playbook said a confirmed reclaim of $65,000 — ideally above $66K — upgrades the call to BUY, and Monday's full book delivered exactly that: BTC at ~$66,831, above the $66K re-entry threshold, on a completed US–Iran peace deal and a +2.38% Nasdaq. The macro mechanism is now working in BTC's favor end-to-end: Hormuz reopening → oil collapses → inflation expectations fall → the dollar eases → discount rate for BTC falls. This is the regime turn the structural thesis needed. The call moves to BUY at MEDIUM conviction — medium, not high, for one reason: FOMC June 17. A non-hawkish Warsh (hold/dovish) confirms and opens $70K–$73K, at which point this upgrades to high conviction. A hawkish surprise (hike signal) is the live risk that spikes the dollar and could pull BTC back under $65K — so scale in, keep some dry powder for the post-FOMC confirmation, and size the FOMC tail. Buy the regime turn, respect Wednesday.

analysis:
## The trigger fired

The playbook has been explicit for weeks: a confirmed reclaim of $65,000 — ideally back above the $66K re-entry threshold the markets briefings kept flagging — upgrades the call from HOLD to BUY. Today, on Monday's full liquidity, it happened. BTC pushed +2.3% to ~$66,831, holding decisively above $65K and printing a $67,302 high, with the [US–Iran peace deal declared 'now complete'](https://www.coinspeaker.com/bitcoin-rebounds-66k-us-iran-peace-deal/) and the Nasdaq ripping +2.38%.

## The macro mechanism is now working end-to-end

This is the regime turn, not a relief bounce. [Brent fell ~4.5% to ~$83 on the Hormuz-reopening commitment](https://www.freepressjournal.in/business/bitcoin-hits-two-week-high-after-usiran-peace-deal-boosts-risk-appetite). Trace it through: Hormuz reopens → the supply-shock premium unwinds → oil collapses → inflation expectations fall → the dollar eases → the discount rate for long-duration assets like BTC falls. Every link in that chain is now pointing the same direction, which is exactly what the structural bull case has been missing since the spring.

## Why BUY — but only medium conviction

The call moves to BUY because the trigger objectively fired and the full Monday book confirmed the weekend break. It is MEDIUM conviction, not high, for one reason: [the FOMC lands Wednesday and Warsh's first decision is the key](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/cryptocurrencies/btc/261967259-crypto-bitcoin-btc-fed-fomc-iran-kevin-warsh-rate-cut-tradingkey). Positioning has flipped decisively bullish — put/call 0.92, funding positive, ETF flows green — which is both the bull case and the risk: a hawkish surprise now has a crowded long book to flush back under $65K.

## How to play it

Scale in, don't lunge. Buy the regime turn here, keep dry powder for the post-FOMC confirmation, and size the Wednesday tail. A non-hawkish Warsh takes this to $70K–$73K and upgrades conviction to high; a hike signal spikes the dollar and reverses risk. [Traders aren't pricing BTC above $75K yet while Trump still warns of further Iran strikes](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/06/15/live-markets-bitcoin-not-fully-out-of-danger-as-trump-warns-of-further-iran-strikes) and the deal isn't signed until June 19. Bulls have the regime; the Fed has the last word.
